/* id="selectTechs" */ SELECT AI_JOB_TECH_ID aiJobTechId ,ANALYSIS_ID analysisId ,TECH_NAME techName ,REQUIREMENT_TYPE requirementType ,MATCH_STATUS matchStatus FROM AI_JOB_TECH WHERE ANALYSIS_ID = #{analysisId} ORDER BY REQUIREMENT_TYPE ,TECH_NAME

/* id="selectRecommendations" */ SELECT R.RECOMMEND_ID recommendId ,R.ANALYSIS_ID analysisId ,R.PROJECT_ID projectId ,P.PROJECT_NAME projectName ,R.RANK_NO rankNo ,R.REASON reason ,R.SOURCE_DETAIL sourceDetail ,R.SAVED_YN savedYn ,R.CREATED_AT createdAt FROM AI_EXPERIENCE_RECOMMEND R LEFT JOIN PROJECT_EXPERIENCE P ON P.PROJECT_ID = R.PROJECT_ID WHERE R.ANALYSIS_ID = #{analysisId} ORDER BY R.RANK_NO

/* id="selectMemberTechs" */ SELECT DISTINCT T.TECH_NAME FROM TECH_STACK T WHERE T.TECH_ID IN ( SELECT PT.TECH_ID FROM PROJECT_TECH PT JOIN PROJECT_EXPERIENCE P ON P.PROJECT_ID = PT.PROJECT_ID WHERE P.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} UNION SELECT LT.TECH_ID FROM LEARNING_TECH LT JOIN LEARNING_RECORD L ON L.LEARNING_ID = LT.LEARNING_ID WHERE L.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} )
